dedupe_keys.name: mmorwad the multi modal recyclable waste management dataset

description: MMoRWaD contains co-recorded colour images, depth images, video and impact audio for recyclable household objects. The Aristotle University of Thessaloniki team reports 3,300 annotated samples from 721 Greek household items in 18 material classes. COCO detection and segmentation labels accompany the recordings, and the Zenodo release lists archive, CSV and JSON files. The resource concerns individual items, not an operating municipal collection fleet; the site and observation dates of recording are not established in the metadata reviewed. Zenodo lists CC BY 4.0 and public file links. A modeller could use the labelled observations to train or test the recognition component of a reverse-vending machine or automated waste-sorting station, then examine classification errors in a facility operations simulation. The set does not describe bin demand, vehicle routes or plant throughput, so it cannot by itself calibrate a city-wide waste-service model. The recordings and labels were not downloaded or checked. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: MMoRWaD - The Multi Modal Recyclable Waste Management Dataset
notes: G4-0530; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
